findings.summary: A Settings capacity or threshold update would not affect the next public payload because the existing builder emits persisted current_state.band.
findings.requiredCorrection: Own the existing public payload builder and test, derive band at response time from current count and current-effective Settings, leave current_state untouched, freeze the response schema, and prove no private field leakage.

findings.summary: The phase verification profile did not enumerate all settled Owner sibling browser suites.
findings.requiredCorrection: Specify phase11-settings, phase11-access, phase11-audit, phase11-health, phase10-ui-csv, phase9-owner-ui, and phase11-shell browser suites plus the Settings integration suite.

findings.summary: effectiveFromUtc was not narrowed to the repository's canonical serialization.
findings.requiredCorrection: Require Date.toISOString() and YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ round-trip identity.
